node_types.PEP: A Python Enhancement Proposal in (or referenced by) the typing corpus
node_types.Person: An author, sponsor or decision-maker (delegate) of PEPs
node_types.Concept: A typing construct or idea from the curated lexicon
node_types.RejectedIdea: An alternative a PEP considered and explicitly turned down
node_types.Decision: The recorded outcome of a PEP, with its stated rationale
node_types.PythonVersion: A CPython release targeted by a PEP
node_types.Venue: Where a PEP was discussed (mailing list or forum)
node_types.Tool: A type checker or typing tool referenced by PEPs

BUILDS_ON.rule: Reference to an earlier accepted PEP from abstract/motivation/specification

CONTRASTS_WITH.rule: Reference made inside a rejected-alternatives section

INTRODUCES.rule: First accepted PEP focused on the concept

EXTENDS.rule: Later accepted PEP focused on an already-introduced concept

PROPOSES.rule: Non-accepted (draft/rejected/withdrawn) PEP focused on the concept

MENTIONS.rule: Concept discussed but not the PEP's focus

ABOUT.rule: Lexicon match in the idea's heading/text

RAISES.rule: Concern cue in a rejection reason or compat/open-issues section

REVISITED_BY.rule: Derived: a later accepted PEP that cites the rejecting PEP and works on the same concept with similar wording

IMPLEMENTED_IN.rule: Tool named in a reference-implementation section
